name: Micro
headline: Make room for every idea
summary: Explore ideas on an infinite whiteboard with shapes, sticky notes, text, and freehand drawing. Save boards and return to your work anytime.

benefits.title: Think without edges
benefits.body: Pan and zoom across an infinite canvas as your ideas grow.

benefits.title: Draw it your way
benefits.body: Combine rectangles, lines, text, sticky notes, and freehand marks on one board.

benefits.title: Pick up where you left off
benefits.body: Create multiple boards, rename them, and rely on automatic saving.

howItWorks.title: Create a board
howItWorks.body: Open a new canvas for a brainstorm, wireframe, or visual plan.

howItWorks.title: Build your idea
howItWorks.body: Add shapes, notes, text, and drawings; move and resize them as you work.

howItWorks.title: Return and refine
howItWorks.body: Your board saves automatically so you can continue later.
